Why Fingers Prune in Water? — Pruney bath fingers are NOT soggy skin—your brain turns them into rain tires!
Kids science answer for "why fingers wrinkle in water for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Your nervous system narrows tiny blood vessels under wet skin to build rain-tire wrinkles that help your fingers grip slippery toys underwater.
